_meta.description: Plant stage configurations. Fill erection_lump and electrical_base for each stage.

1.name: 1-Stage Primary Crushing
1.description: VGF → Jaw Crusher → Single-deck screen. Suitable for road metal, base course, aggregates up to 40mm.
1.electrical_note: [To be confirmed] Estimated for 1-stage with jaw soft-starter
1.notes: [To be confirmed by engineering] 1-stage suitable for < 150 TPH road metal applications

2.name: 2-Stage Primary + Secondary
2.description: VGF → Jaw → Cone → Multi-deck screen. Standard aggregate plant.
2.electrical_note: Cone with soft starter. Add ~4L for VFD drives.

3.name: 3-Stage Primary + Secondary + Tertiary VSI
3.description: VGF → Jaw → Cone → VSI → Multi-deck screen. Full gradation plant with M-sand capability.
3.electrical_note: VSI-300 plant ~49-51L; VSI-5080 plant ~88L. Includes MCC panel.
3.notes: Standard 3-stage. WSG-70 addon for wet M-sand.

4.name: 4-Stage Primary + Secondary + Dual Tertiary
4.description: VGF → Jaw → Cone → VSI (shaping) → Secondary VSI (sand) → Screens. High-value shaped aggregate + M-sand plant.
4.electrical_note: [To be confirmed] Dual VSI + Cone + Jaw. Includes SCADA/PLC panel.
4.notes: [To be confirmed] 4-stage for railway ballast + shaped aggregate + M-sand simultaneous production
